lines.speaker: header
lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 839 Complaint No. File Number 05-0157-955

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he talk a lot about killing people? (pause) Stay with me here. Did he talk a lot about killing people?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: When was the first time he had mentioned killing somebody?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: A few days before October 31st.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And how did that get brought up?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz we were watchin' TV and on the news there was someone that killed someone.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. And what did he say when he saw that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he was gonna plan to kill someone and.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And who did he say he was gonna plan to kill?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: The girl that takes the pictures of cars for a magazine.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And he told you that while he was sitting at his house, watching TV?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you say anything to him like you shouldn't do that or?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he ask you to help him?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What did he ask you to do specifically?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I can't remember.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. Good. Can't remember why'd you say that?
